{"metadata":{"description":"Weak-network adaptor for the DeepSeek Harness — 弱网适配插件","id":"gh:1335918078","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-plugin-weaknet-adaptor","slug":"jiay98528-dev/dsh-plugin-weaknet-adaptor","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Weak-network adaptor for the DeepSeek Harness — 弱网适配插件"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 🌐 dsh-plugin-weaknet-adaptor"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Weak-network adaptor for the DeepSeek Harness — 弱网适配插件**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Keep model reply chains alive on flaky networks: transparent long-backoff retries, local response ca"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"che, heartbeat auto-reconnect, and degraded-mode token economy — with a fully structured, bilingual "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"(zh/en) settings page."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"弱网下保护模型回复链条不断裂：透明长退避重试、本地响应缓存、心跳自动重连、降级省 token——全部参数结构化，设置页中英双语。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## ✨ Features / 特性"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| | 中文 | English |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| 🔁 | 模型流在 `llm/stream` 瀑布层透明拦截：降级模式下全缓冲 + 指数退避重试（默认最长等待 10 分钟），网络抖动不再打断回复链条 | Transparent intercept"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ion in the `llm/stream` waterfall: degraded mode buffers and retries with exponential backoff (up to"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" a 10-minute cap by default), so network blips no longer break the reply chain |
| 💾 | 完整成功响应本地缓存（请求"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"指纹 key、LRU、TTL 可配）：相同请求零 token 本地重放 | Local replay cache for fully successful responses (fingerprint"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" keys, LRU, configurable TTL): identical requests replay with zero tokens |
| ❤️ | 断网后本地心跳任务按指数退避自动探"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"测重连（间隔上限默认 10 分钟）；任意模型流成功也立即被动恢复 | After an outage a local heartbeat task probes and auto-reconnects"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" with exponential backoff (cap: 10 minutes by default); any successful model stream passively restor"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"es online state |
| 🪙 | 重试等待期间零模型调用（零 token）；重连后可选输出上限降级与 tool-result 确定性裁剪 | Zero model calls (zero"},{"id":"p8s9","text":" tokens) while waiting; optional output-cap and deterministic tool-result pruning after reconnect |
"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"| 🎛️ | 24 个参数全部结构化（分组/类型/范围/默认值），设置页「弱网适配」可全部调整 | All 24 parameters are fully structured (group/type"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"/range/default) and adjustable in the "Weak Network" settings page |
| 🌍 | 每个参数的说明与场景预期效果均为中英双语，UI 跟"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"随系统语言 | Every parameter ships with bilingual (zh/en) descriptions and expected-effect notes; the UI "},{"id":"p8s13","text":"follows the interface language |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## 🚀 Install / 安装"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Add to your composition (`cordis.yml`), e.g. in the DSH profile you run:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The Host half activates automatically; the browser half (settings page + status dock) is
picked up t"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"hrough the package's `dsh.client` declaration and served by `client-modules` —
no extra wiring neede"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"d. Peer dependencies (`@deepseek-ai/*`, `cordis`) are installed
automatically by npm."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"> 💡 **为什么用正式包而不是动态插件？** 动态插件（会话内 `cordis_define` 创建）只存在于进程内存，进程崩溃或重启后即丢失；本包由 `cordis.yml` 静态加载，重启后依然"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"生效，真正"安装即用"。
>
> 💡 **Why a real package instead of a dynamic plugin?** Dynamic plugins live only in "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"process memory and vanish on crash/restart; this package is loaded statically from `cordis.yml` and "},{"id":"p14s4","text":" vanish on crash/restart; this package is loaded statically from `cordis.yml` and survives restarts."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## ⚙️ Configuration / 参数配置"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"All parameters can be changed live from **Settings → Weak Network**（设置 → 弱网适配）.
Changes persist best"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"-effort to `<workspaceRoot>/.dsh/weaknet-params.json`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| 组 Group | 参数 Key | 类型 Type | 默认 Default | 说明与预期效果 Description & expected effect |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| 总开关 Master | `enabled` | boolean | `true` | 总开关；关闭后完全恢复原生流程。Master switch; off restores the native"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" flow entirely. |
| 网络探测与心跳 Probing & heartbeat | `probeUrl` | string | `https://www.gstatic.com/gen"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"erate_204` | 心跳探测地址；任意 HTTP 响应（含非 2xx）视为可达。Probe URL; any HTTP response (incl. non-2xx) counts as re"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"achable. 内网/代理环境请改内网轻量端点。 |
| | `probeTimeoutMs` | number | `5000` | 探测超时（500–60000）。调小判定更快但高延迟易误报。P"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"robe timeout; smaller = faster detection, larger = fewer false positives. |
| | `probeMode` | enum |"},{"id":"p18s6","text":" `fetch` | `fetch`（web 服务探测）/ `off`（仅被动恢复）。`off` 用于无 fetch provider 的环境。 |
| | `heartbeatBaseInterva"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"lMs` | number | `1000` | 探测失败后的初始间隔（200–60000）。Heartbeat base interval. |
| | `heartbeatMaxIntervalM"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"s` | number | **`600000`** | **重连最长等待（10 分钟）**（10000–3600000）。间隔指数增长到此封顶。**Longest reconnect wait (1"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"0 min) — the interval caps here.** |
| | `heartbeatBackoffFactor` | number | `2` | 探测间隔倍增系数（1.1–5）；抖"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"动频繁建议接近 1.1。 |
| | `successThreshold` | number | `1` | 连续成功多少次判定恢复（1–10）；波动网络建议 2–3。 |
| | `critical"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"Failures` | number | `3` | 连续失败达到该次数状态变红（离线告警），此前为黄（弱网）。 |
| 请求重试 Request retry | `maxAttempts` | nu"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"mber | `10` | 单个请求最大重试次数（1–100）；超限按原流程终止，消息不丢。 |
| | `backoffBaseMs` | number | `1000` | 重试基础退避（100–"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"60000）。 |
| | `backoffMaxMs` | number | `600000` | 重试退避上限（1000–3600000）。 |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## 🧠 How it works / 工作原理"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **重试为何放在 `llm/stream` 而不是 `agent/request-error`？** 宿主 `llm-retry` 默认已接管 `agent/request-error`（`DEF"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"AULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` 覆盖 TRANSPORT/TIMEOUT 等），后注册的监听器会被短路；`llm/stream` 是每个模型请求必经的瀑布，可确定性接管。`agent/re"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"quest-error` 仅作降级观察。
- **缓存指纹**：`provider + model + reasoningEffort + temperature + maxTokens + stop"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" + system + tools + messages + purpose`（键排序规范序列化）。只有逐字节一致的请求才命中。
- **不做什么**：不做工具集裁剪（动态插件沙箱白名单限制不适用于本"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"包，但裁剪工具集会改变模型能力面，保持克制）；不做流中断"前缀续传"（LLM API 不支持续传，重试即重新生成）。
- **RPC**：设置页通过 `@Remote`（`dsh-typert-pro"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"tocol`）的 SRC markers 机制调用 `weaknet/*` 命名空间（`getParamDefs / getParams / setParams / getStatus / reset"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"Stats`），无需手写 typert 生成物。"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## 🧪 Quick verification / 快速验证"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"1. 打开 设置 → **弱网适配**：状态卡 + 7 组参数（每项有双语说明与「▸ 预期效果」）。
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## 🛠 Development / 开发"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Layout:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"}],"truncated":true}
